R16.example: Once a campaign advances, {x} live causal variables sit under every settlement (food security, public legitimacy, defense readiness, criminal opportunity, and the rest) each with a score, a band ({x}), and named contributors. Above them ride {x} pressures: the directional strain on the settlement, each carrying its own reasons, so “high external threat” always names the deployment or the famine driving it. Advance time and they shift together: a war drains economic capacity, which lowers the settlement’s strength, which feeds the drive back toward peace. That loop is why the war layer ends its own wars; peace is the equilibrium it returns to, not a script.
